第9章 老子就不信按不服你坏了中计（第1页）
只留下了几个影影绰绰的婆娑倒影。
林间竹屋之内，那原始的碰撞，却是一直未停！
老丑全不惜力，就算她自身的意志再坚定，也难受如此糟蹋。
“只要你跟我求饶，我现在就可以饶了你。“
“不管你怎么想，你的身子已经被我破了，你以后就是我的人了。“
“好好跟着我，我也不会亏待你！“
只有眼神，却是仍然坚毅，死死盯着老丑，仇视不屈。
“好，好，既然你不知好歹，那么就别怪我了！“
老丑见她死不屈服，心里怒气中也是多了一丝惊讶。
却始终像块捂不热的寒冰，半个字都不肯松口。
老丑捏住她的下巴，逼她看着自己。
冷笑一声：“你宁死不求饶，你觉得自己是那贱货苏若雪的闺友不成？“
“你说，若是她知道我这个她眼里的老废物、老垃圾破了你的身，她会怎么看你？“
却依旧咬着牙，从牙缝里挤出一句：“你敢！“
老丑俯下身，在她耳边一字一句道：“现在，给我跪下求饶，喊我一声主人。“
“不然，我就全程留影，再把它发遍大街小巷。“
“让全天下的人都看看，苏若雪手下最骄傲的死士，在我身下是个什么样子。“

“你猜，到那个时刻，苏若雪还敢冒天下之大不韪要你？“
“你不过是她养的一条狗！你给谁做狗不是做！不如做我奴犬，我会更疼爱你！”
夜璇虽然在他刻意鞭挞下疼的面容扭曲。
但是眼神之中却反而露出了笑意，眼神里满是轻蔑。
将夜璇推到床上，老丑拿起了旁边的被褥。
将其撕成几根细条反绑了她的双手手腕。让其移动不得。
“让你狂，我让你再狂，看我不弄死你！“
只可惜，夜璇的傲气却是并非如此容易压服。
夜璇本就身上有伤，又是进行了这么长时间的折磨。
见夜璇如此坚毅，也是出乎老丑的预料。
前后几个时辰，几乎把她折腾得脱了力。
但就算如此，也没有让她开口求饶一句。
之前老丑敢于这样放心羞辱夜璇，就是他检查过，附近没有其他人烟。
老丑忽地想起，马元庆有一女儿。名马映雪。
昔年还是神女大会十二仙子候选人之一，听说也是一位难得的美人，只不过他没有真正见过。
若昔日妙手剑客马元庆退隐在此，那她女儿应该也不会远离。
竹屋布置雅致，其中还看出不少女儿家心思。
几个闪身追了出去，追出数百米，却不见半个人影。

Chapter 9 I don’t believe you fell into the trap (Page 1)
Only a few shadowy and whirling reflections were left.
In the bamboo house in the forest, the primitive collision never stops!
Lao Chou spared no effort, no matter how strong her own will was, she couldn't bear to be so ruined.
"As long as you beg me for mercy, I can spare you now."
"No matter what you think, your body has been broken by me, and you will be mine from now on."
"Follow me well and I won't treat you badly!"
Only his eyes were there, but they were still resolute, staring at the old man with unyielding hatred.
"Okay, okay, since you don't know what's good or bad, then don't blame me!"
Seeing that she refused to give in, the old Chou felt a little surprised in his anger.
But he is always like a piece of ice that cannot hold any heat, refusing to let go of even a single word.
Lao Chou pinched her chin and forced her to look at him.
He sneered: "You would rather die than beg for mercy. Do you think you are the best friend of that bitch Su Ruoxue?"
"Tell me, what would she think of you if she knew that I, an old loser and trash in her eyes, had broken your body?"
But he still gritted his teeth and squeezed out a sentence from between his teeth: "You dare!"
The old man leaned down and whispered in her ear: "Now, kneel down and beg for mercy, and call me master."
"Otherwise, I will take photos of the whole process and post them all over the streets."
"Let everyone in the world see what Su Ruoxue's proudest soldier looks like underneath me."
"Guess, at that moment, Su Ruoxue still dares to risk the disapproval of the world to want you?"
"You are just a dog she raised! You are not a dog for anyone! Why not be my slave dog? I will love you more!"
Although Ye Xuan's face was twisted in pain under his deliberate whipping.
But instead there was a smile in his eyes, full of contempt.
Pushing Ye Xuan onto the bed, Lao Chou picked up the quilt next to him.
He tore it into several thin strips and tied her wrists behind her back. Don't let it move.
"If I make you crazy, I'll make you crazy again. See if I don't kill you!"
Unfortunately, Ye Xuan's arrogance is not so easy to subdue.
Ye Xuan was already injured and had been tortured for such a long time.
Seeing Ye Xuan's determination was beyond Lao Chou's expectation.
For several hours, she was almost exhausted from the torture.
But even so, she was not allowed to ask for mercy.
Old Chou dared to humiliate Ye Xuan like this before because he had checked that there was no one else nearby.
Lao Chou suddenly remembered that Ma Yuanqing had a daughter. The famous horse Ying Xue.
In the past, she was one of the twelve fairies candidates at the Goddess Conference. She was said to be a rare beauty, but he had never really seen her.
If the former master swordsman Ma Yuanqing retired here, then her daughter would not be far away either.
The bamboo house is elegantly decorated, and a lot of the daughter's family's thoughts can be seen in it.
A few of them ducked and chased him for hundreds of meters, but no one was in sight.
